title: Signoff decisions file
description: A list of decisions for a person to make on a local page. All text is plain text; line breaks are kept, nothing is rendered as HTML or Markdown.

tab.description: A short label for this round's tab when a folder of rounds is served. Default: the title.

intro.description: One or two sentences under the heading.

notice.description: A short notice shown as a banner under the header, e.g. "Synthetic data only".

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag of the content, e.g. "en" or "de". Default "en".

context.description: One line on which session asks and what it was working on, e.g. "feat/parser session: splitting the tokenizer". Shown on the round's page and its inbox row. Never a prompt, a transcript, a secret or a path. The pattern refuses control and line-separator characters; Signoff also refuses a blank value and the invisible characters a command's text refuses. Needs Signoff 0.5.0.

free_text.description: The free-text box at the end of the page. It is always shown; this only names it.

id.description: Unique and stable: the answers are keyed by it.

group.description: A heading is shown whenever this changes from the item before.

cost.description: What it costs: effort, lines, tokens, money, risk.

select.description: one: radio buttons. many: checkboxes. number: a slider and a number field, between range's min and max (needs Signoff 0.5.0 or newer).

options.description: At least two when select is "one". Required for "one" and "many", refused for "number".

recommended.description: Preselected and labelled. An option id for "one", a list of option ids for "many", a number in range and on its step for "number" (required there).

comment.description: Show a comment box under the options.

other.description: Add an "Other" choice with its own text field. It is recorded as the choice "_other", with the text in "other".

skippable.description: Add a "Skip" choice. It is recorded as the choice "_skip", on its own.

marks.description: Let the user draw rectangles on this item's pictures, each with a comment. They are recorded in the answer's "marks".

sensitive.description: The answer may hold personal data: the item starts marked Private. It only acts on an item with a text field (comment, other or marks). The user can untick it, or tick it on any item. A private answer is recorded with "private": true; its text stays in the answers file, and the Markdown copy hides its comment, Other text and mark comments.

criteria.description: What the options are compared on, in row order. With it, each option's facts show as chips on its card, and a Cards / Table toggle shows the options side by side, a row per criterion. The choice is the same in both views; the view is not saved.

attachments.description: Text files read when Signoff starts and shown under the options, each in a collapsed box as plain text: nothing in them is rendered. At most 20 an item and 200 a round. The Markdown copy names them only. Not changed by sensitive: the text is yours, not the user's.

commands.description: Commands for the user to run before deciding, each shown under the description as a wrapped code block with a Copy button that copies the text exactly, and a hint under one that deletes a relative path, whatever its lang. Signoff never runs them, and the user should read one before running it. The Markdown copy gives each as one line. Needs Signoff 0.5.0 or newer.

blocking.description: Your next step waits on this item. The page marks it, with a word, in its title and in the sidebar, and the Summary gets a filter that shows only these items. Mark few. Not in the answers file or the Markdown copy. Needs Signoff 0.5.0 or newer.

stakes.description: How much rides on this decision. The page shows it in the margin with a glyph and a word (▲ High stakes, ● Medium, ▼ Low), and marks high in the sidebar. In the Markdown copy, not in the answers file. Needs Signoff 0.5.0 or newer.

irreversible.description: The decision cannot be undone, and why, in one line. The margin shows it under the heading Cannot be undone, and the sidebar marks the item. Leave it out when it can be undone. One line as for context. In the Markdown copy, not in the answers file. Needs Signoff 0.5.0 or newer.

settled.description: Where and when the user decided this before, in one line ("round-01, 11-14"); recommended is that decision. The item starts folded with that choice and a Change button, counts as decided while its choice is the recommendation, and is never marked elsewhere. One line as for context. In the Markdown copy, not in the answers file. Needs Signoff 0.5.0 or newer.

range.description: A number item's values: min to max on step, at most 10,000 steps. The answer's choice is one of them, a JSON number, or "_skip" or null. Only with select "number".

step.description: The values are min plus a whole number of steps.

unit.description: Shown after the value, such as % or HUF. One line.

text.description: The command as the user pastes it, at most 4000 characters and 60 lines. Line breaks and tabs are kept. Refused: a start or end with a space or line break (a trailing one runs on paste), and the known invisible and blank characters (as for caption and lang: a control character but tab and newline; a format, separator, surrogate, private-use or unassigned one; a Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, such as a bidi override, a zero-width mark or a variation selector; the Braille blank U+2800 and U+FFFC). The block wraps; the user should still read it before running it.

lang.description: The language shown in the block's bar, such as bash. Default: code.

caption.description: One line of plain text above the block, also the Copy button's name. Unlike text and lang it may hold an emoji: U+FE0F and U+200D are allowed here.

src.description: Path relative to the decisions file, inside its folder (links are followed): a .md or .txt file, UTF-8, up to 256 KiB. A round's attachments together: up to 2 MiB as they go into the page, where <, > and & take 6 bytes each. No drive, network or absolute path. The page shows this name.

id.description: Unique within the item; the options' facts are keyed by it.

tone.description: How the value compares: shown as ▲ (good), ● (mid) or ▼ (bad) beside the text, and in colour; never colour alone.

image.description: A picture (src) or a board (html): exactly one of the two.

src.description: Path relative to the decisions file. It must stay inside that folder. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; no SVG.

html.description: A board: one self-contained HTML file relative to the decisions file, inside its folder, up to 2 MiB. Inline CSS and JS, data: images; nothing loads from outside, and it must hold nothing secret. It runs sandboxed and reads ?theme=light or ?theme=dark from its URL.

alt.description: Text for screen readers. Default: the caption, else the item title.

boxes.description: Highlight boxes as [x, y, w, h] in percent of the image, the meaning of W3C Media Fragments xywh=percent.

detail.description: A short line under the label.

facts.description: This option's value on the item's criteria, keyed by criterion id. Only the item's own criteria; a criterion left out shows as a dash in the table.
